adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Corvus Glaive comes through time with Thanos to fight at the ruined Avengers Compound. When Thanos orders him to rain fire on the battlefield, Corvus warns that it will hit their own troops, then obeys.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Corvus's adoptive father, who orders him to fire on their own troops.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Thanos's adopted son, who fires on the battlefield at his order.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Battle of Earth: Thanos asks where Nebula is and Corvus reports she is not responding; after Wanda overpowers him, Thanos orders Corvus to have the Sanctuary II rain fire; Corvus protests 'But, sire, our troops!' and is told 'Just do it!', then gives the order.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Cull Obsidian comes through time with Thanos and fights for him at the ruined Avengers Compound, until he is crushed during the battle.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cull's adoptive father, who brings him through time to fight the Avengers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Thanos's adopted son, who fights for him at the Avengers Compound.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: the 2014 Thanos transports his army, Cull included, to 2023 and summons the Black Order down from the Sanctuary II to the Compound ruins; Cull fights Steve, Korg, Drax and Tony for him and is stomped to death by Scott as Giant-Man. No dialogue between them; the stage rests on Cull acting for Thanos.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: For Thanos, Ebony Maw searches the memories of the Nebula of 2014 and finds a second Nebula from the future sharing them. He calls her a traitor and moves to execute her, but Thanos spares her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Maw's adoptive sister, whose memories he searches before trying to execute her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Nebula's adoptive brother, who searches her memories and tries to execute her as a traitor.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Sanctuary II in 2014: Thanos has Maw examine Nebula's glitching synaptic drive; Maw finds 'another Nebula' with a time stamp nine years in the future, plays her memories, then fashions a chain around Nebula's neck to execute her as a traitor until Thanos spares her. The app's single Nebula file covers both Nebulas.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#123
adds.text: Simmons arrives with an upgraded Zephyr to save May and get the team away. When Deke asks where Fitz is, she tells him she does not know and cannot know.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Deke's grandmother, who cannot tell him where Fitz is.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's grandson, who asks her where Fitz is.
adds.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6E13 'New Life' (episode 123 overall: 5 x 22 + 13): Simmons appears with a team and an upgraded Zephyr and puts May in stasis; Deke watches her heal May and, when he asks about Fitz, Simmons says she does not know, nor could she know.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#6
adds.text: Deke catches Enoch working on an unconscious Simmons and shuts him down, and Simmons reveals an implant that keeps her from knowing where Fitz is. Deke promises to keep her secret.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Deke's grandmother, who trusts him with the secret of her memory implant.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's grandson, who keeps the secret of her memory implant.
adds.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7E6 'Adapt or Die': while repairing the time drive, Deke sees Enoch implanting a device in Simmons and shocks him; Simmons explains the D.I.A.N.A. implant blocks her knowledge of Fitz's location, and Deke agrees to carry the secret with her and Enoch.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
adds.text: Deke helps Fitz with the Quantum Tunnel that can send everyone back to their own timeline, then chooses to stay behind so Fitz and the others can go home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Deke's grandfather, whom he helps send home before staying behind.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's grandson, who stays behind so the team can go home.
adds.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7E13 'What We're Fighting For': Fitz, newly arrived, signals Deke to help get the Quantum Tunnel onto the Zephyr; Deke works out how to expand the bubble and volunteers to stay in the new timeline to run the machine, saying they will see him again when Fitz and Simmons have a grandchild.

adds.title: Jessica Jones S2#2
adds.text: Jessica breaks into Dorothy's home to find out what she told Trish, and Dorothy swings a golf club at her. Dorothy says Trish has gone to see Max Tatum, and Jessica scolds her for letting her near him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Dorothy's adoptive daughter, who breaks in to find out where Trish went.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's adoptive mother, who swings a golf club at her when she breaks in.
adds.evidence: Jessica Jones S2E2 'AKA Freak Accident': Jessica calls Dorothy asking where Trish is, then breaks in; Dorothy swings a golf club and misses, explains Trish went to see Max Tatum, and Jessica angrily scolds her. They clash again in S2E12.

adds.title: Jessica Jones S2#2
adds.text: Over lunch, Trish asks Dorothy about Max Tatum. Dorothy calls out her lies and warns her off him, but gives her the information anyway.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Dorothy's daughter, who asks her about Max Tatum.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Trish's mother, who warns her off Max Tatum.
adds.evidence: Jessica Jones S2E2: Dorothy meets Trish for lunch; Trish asks about Max Tatum, Dorothy calls out her lies and warns her not to, then gives her the information. Later in S2 (E5) Trish slaps Dorothy over the botched proposal, and Dorothy sits with her in hospital in E12-E13.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: The 2014 Gamora stands by as Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and tries to execute her. Is sharing that small scene, both serving Thanos, enough for an Endgame stage between Maw and Gamora?
options: Add a family stage: 'Gamora watches with Thanos as Maw searches Nebula's memories and tries to execute her as a traitor.'
owner_calls.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Sanctuary II in 2014: Gamora, Thanos and Maw watch Nebula's memories together; Maw prepares to execute Nebula; no line or act between Maw and Gamora is recorded.
